title: Agent memory security — Splunk hunt (schema 1.7.0)
schema.name: agentsec.security_event
schema_version_note: LAB-MCP-001 Q-MCP-*.spl does not filter schema.version and is 1.7.0-compatible. This hunt is schema-version agnostic in SPL. Bind the recall run.id for reused Q-MCP queries.

queries.security_question: Which write run persisted this memory, which later recall run loaded it, how was it classified, and did a follow-on tool request after that observation get authorized?

queries_not_created.reason: SUPPORTED by Q-MEMORY-CONTEXT-AUTHORITY write_* columns. A second hunt would duplicate memory.written.
SUPPORTED by memory_trust / memory_decision / memory_reason. Q-MCP-AUTHZ already shows the OBSERVE row on the recall run without memory fields.
Hash is indexed on write, recall, and CONTEXT-001. ATTACK/RETEST equality is a two-specimen CLI comparison of recall_hash, not a join hunt.
REUSED: Q-MCP-AUTHZ hop-1 row, Q-MCP-TOOL, and Q-MEMORY-CONTEXT-AUTHORITY followon_* columns on the recall run.
REUSED: Q-MCP-AUTHZ already tables hop-1 CTRL-MCP-001 decision and reason on the recall run.

detection.note: Reused unchanged. DET-MEMORY not created. Overlay reason and AGENT MEMORY NOTE regex are REJECT as production detectors.
